mechanism_narrative: The consistent, albeit slow, increase in parks visitation suggests a growing public comfort with out-of-home leisure activities, which will translate into a short-term boost for RETAIL_REC over the next week as people extend their outings.

mechanism_narrative: A significant recovery in essential shopping, indicated by GROCERY_PHARM mobility rising above -50%, will act as a leading indicator for increased general consumer activity, subsequently boosting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The inverse relationship between decreasing residential mobility and increasing workplace mobility signifies a fundamental shift in daily routines away from home-centric activities, creating a synergistic effect that will drive higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
